description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that contains a LogView and manages its display and behavior, including view inflation, text change handling, and layout setup.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a LogView inside a ScrollView, handles view creation, layout, and text change events.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, sets layout parameters, padding, typeface, gravity, and text appearance, then returns the ScrollView containing the LogView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets a TextWatcher on the LogView to auto-scroll on text change, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
